name: Language-Aware Images
description: TMDB images in your library's language with a clean fallback to English, no more textless posters.
overview: Drop-in replacement for the built-in TMDB image provider. Enforces a clean cascade: library language → English → (optional) textless. Within each bucket images are sorted by vote_count DESC like TMDB's own /images UI. Fixes jellyfin/jellyfin#9878 (built-in prefers textless over English fallback).
changelog: Fixes the regional-variant ranking from v0.8.0 (issue #2 follow-up). Images are now tagged with the library metadata language so Jellyfin's downstream filter stops dropping regional variants (pt-pt) and override languages in non-matching libraries. The bucket order is enforced through Jellyfin's own sort, so the original language no longer leapfrogs the preferred one on vote count. New OriginalLanguageLast option (default on) puts the original-language bucket after the fallback so international names win; turn it off for the old between-preferred-and-fallback position.
